learning_outcomes.text: Explain the structure of the treated construction and functional materials.
Relate the material behavior of the treated construction and functional materials to the respective microstructural processes.
Name essential material properties of the treated construction and functional materials and their known applications, and furthermore develop possible new applications.
Identify challenges and requirements in processing high-performance materials and select suitable processing methods.
Explain the principles of turning, milling, and grinding, as well as thermal ablation processes for high-performance materials, and identify their application areas according to requirements.
Select suitable tools, cutting materials, and processing parameters for machining high-performance materials and evaluate their effects on surface quality and dimensional accuracy.
Work independently in the field of the treated materials.
Take responsibility for the services rendered.
Work and solve tasks related to the treated materials, also in teams.
Act fairly and cooperatively and be able to deal with conflicts appropriately.
Actively contribute to the development of topics in the field of the treated materials.
Reflect on the importance of processing high-performance materials in modern manufacturing processes and understand the effects on product quality.

syllabus_topics: Thermal ablation processes: Laser and EDM technologies
Independent acquisition of knowledge on a specific topic or strengthening research competence
Familiarization with new topics and critical questioning
Evaluation of the economic and ecological effects of processing high-performance materials
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the written exam (passing grade). Successful participation in the course's internship is a prerequisite for taking the exam. The importance of the grade for the final grade is determined by the Bachelor's examination regulations.
